summary: Retest after two backend fixes: (1) DPT-3 due_rule flipped from 'fixed:06-30' to 'half1:06-30', (2) GET /clients/{id}/obligations no longer auto-seeds SEED_OBLIGATIONS and startup migration deletes legacy rows (missing `code`). Full pytest suite (24 cases) passes on external URL. Adjusted TestObligations.test_seed_and_status_update to assert fresh-client returns [] and then generates 15 obligations before status-update (previously relied on auto-seed >=5).
critical_code_review_comments: Consider documenting rule-kind semantics ('fixed:MM-DD' = FY end year, 'half1:MM-DD' = FY start year, 'half2:MM-DD' = FY end year) at the top of resolve_due() so future statutory dates avoid the DPT-3 mis-classification pattern.
Startup migration delete_many({'code': {'$exists': False}}) is safe today but should be logged and made idempotent-safe (e.g., one-shot flag) in case future documents legitimately omit `code`.
seed_data_creation: Tests create/delete TEST_* clients and TEST_ members per run; session-scoped fixture raises owner client_limit to 50 in Mongo to survive xdist parallelism.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend v2 fully green. DPT-3=2026-06-30, MSME-1-H1=2026-10-31, DIR-3-KYC=2027-09-30, MGT-7=2027-05-30, BM-Q1=2026-06-30 all verified for FY 2026-27. GET /clients/{id}/obligations on a fresh client returns [] (no auto-seed). Idempotency verified: first generate creates 15/skips 0, second call creates 0/skips 15. TestObligations was updated to generate before asserting count. If future changes reintroduce SEED_OBLIGATIONS, that test will need to be revisited.
